Vivo V80 Lite - Packs Impressive Features into a Sleek Design!
Vivo V80 Lite is also a part of the new V80 series, and yes, it still supports 5G. We’ve kept an eye on this device, and whatever we’ve gathered so far is put inside this preliminary spec sheet. It’s not an original. Apparently, Vivo V80 Lite is just a rebranded Vivo S2. So their specs match one-to-one. Expect the screen to be at least 6.83” in size. This will be an AMOLED. The screen caps at 120Hz RR and 1.5K resolution. Vivo V80 Lite would also carry a 3000 nits peak brightness, and there will be a 32MP camera on the screen. 50MP main camera is also a possibility here, since that’s what we see on the S2. The camera bar will be horizontal. There’s no other camera on the back, so it’s a bland setup. We can confirm that the main sensor is a Sony IMX852. Dimensity 7360 Turbo is the chipset aboard Vivo V80 Lite 5G. This newcomer is supposed to be very thin at around a 7.39mm profile. But it actually puts a 7,050mAh battery inside the chassis, despite that thin design. There are dual speakers, of course. The fingerprint reader is on the screen, and it’s an optical sensor. This V80 Lite 5G does not have Android 17 out of the box. You are working with Android 16 x Origin OS 6 by default. Vivo V80 Lite will trade blows with the Samsung Galaxy A57, but it's a clear win for the Vivo device in terms of battery life.
